type.name: Result
type.doc: Main source of communication of operation success. To check for success {::status} *must* be compared with {Status::Ok}. If there is any error there is {::error} string which is compile-time. It communicates the source of problems even in Release mode. The string contains function name and error message.

member.name: error
member.doc: Error message. nullptr or 'Operation Succeeded.' if no error.
